title: American Horror Story
lead_cast: see List of American Horror Story cast members
premise_summary: American Horror Story (AHS) is an American horror anthology television series created by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk for the cable network FX. The first installment in the American Story media franchise, seasons of AHS are mostly conceived as self-contained miniseries, following a different set of characters in a new setting within the same fictional universe, and a storyline with its own beginning, middle, and end. Some plot elements of each season are loosely inspired by true events.
